title: Extra Golems Fabric
description: A Fabric port of Extra Golems, adding dozens of golems with unique textures and abilities.
body:
Extra Golems Fabric is an altered Fabric port of the original Extra Golems mod.

Original Extra Golems was created by Skyler James / skyjay1 and maintained with the MMD Team:
https://github.com/MinecraftModDevelopmentMods/Extra-Golems

This version ports the Forge mod to Fabric for Minecraft 1.20.1. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original authors.
Build a Structure (Main Method)
The golem structure is the same shape as a vanilla Iron Golem / Snow Golem — a T-shape :

- Head : Place a Golem Head on top. You get a Golem Head by using the Golem Spell item on a Carved Pumpkin (right-click).
- Body (below head) : 2 blocks tall, made of the target material (e.g. 2 Diamond Blocks for a Diamond Golem).
- Arms : 1 block on each side of the upper body (left & right, or north & south). Must be the same material as the body.
- The structure works in both orientations (north-south arms or east-west arms).
For example, to build a Diamond Golem : place a Golem Head on top, 2 Diamond Blocks below it, and 1 Diamond Block on each side of the upper body.
Total unique golem types (grouping all color/style variants): 83
